metadata.summary: A labeled large-scale, high resolution chest x-ray dataset with >160,000 images from 67,000 patients, interpreted and reported by radiologists at Hospital San Juan (Spain) from 2009 to 2017; includes six position views, demographic metadata, and multi-label annotations derived from radiology reports.
metadata.custodian: Hospital Universitario de San Juan, Alicante, Spain
metadata.purpose: Automated exploration of medical images along with their associated radiology reports; supporting development of AI models for chest x-ray interpretation.

papers.title: PadChest — A large chest x-ray image dataset with multi-label annotated reports

ethics.privacy_measures: Data de-identified prior to release; no explicit details on anonymization methods (e.g., removal of DICOM tags, face blurring).

known_limitations: Single-center origin limits generalizability to other healthcare settings.
Reports in Spanish only; potential language barrier for non-Spanish-speaking researchers.
Labeling relies partly on automated methods with known residual error (Micro-F1 = 0.93).
No demographic breakdown (age, sex, ethnicity) reported; representativeness unknown.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — labels partially generated via RNN-based NLP model; original reports were processed to extract and map findings to UMLS taxonomy.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center Spanish cohort; unknown demographic diversity; no evidence of intentional sampling for representativeness.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Hierarchical taxonomy includes 174 findings, 19 diagnoses, 104 locations — likely long-tail distribution; not quantified in source text.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability outside similar Spanish public hospital settings; no formal external validation reported.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage data reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, geography beyond Spain).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No explicit reporting of missing data rates in source text.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Images and reports were obtained from routine clinical practice at Hospital San Juan (Spain); no explicit rationale for patient or study selection beyond routine reporting.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Consecutive clinical studies from 2009–2017; no explicit description of sampling strategy (e.g., random, stratified, or convenience).
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected from 2009 to 2017; no explicit documentation of temporal shifts in equipment, protocols, or reporting practices.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing chest x-ray imaging at Hospital Universitario de San Juan, Alicante, Spain.
population.inclusion_criteria: Chest x-ray examinations performed and reported at Hospital San Juan between 2009 and 2017.
population.missing_groups: No information provided on underrepresented or missing groups.

annotation.annotation_method: 27% manually annotated by trained physicians; remaining labels generated via supervised RNN with attention, validated on independent test set (Micro-F1 = 0.93).
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from Spanish-language radiology reports; mapped to UMLS terminology via hierarchical taxonomy.
annotation.label_noise_description: Automatically generated labels (73%) subject to model error; validation achieved Micro-F1 = 0.93, implying residual noise.
